fluff.overview: The Armed Forces of the Federated Suns integrate conventional infantry directly into their Regimental Combat Teams, assigning foot, mechanized, and jump platoons to work permanently alongside BattleMech and armored formations. Jump-capable infantry provide the vertical mobility that AFFS commanders prize in urban combat and rough terrain, able to bypass obstacles and seize elevated positions that ground-bound platoons cannot reach. Carrying man-portable long-range missile launchers alongside their primary weapons, these platoons can engage armored targets at distances well beyond normal infantry range, providing organic fire support that reduces dependence on dedicated armor or artillery assets.
